blocksHtml:
• Description
  • Product Table
  • Video
  • Review

The Ubiquiti airMAX NanoStation M5 (NSM5) is a reliable and affordable 5GHz outdoor CPE (Customer Premises Equipment) designed for long-range wireless broadband connectivity. It features a 16 dBi dual-polarity antenna, 150+ Mbps real TCP/IP throughput, and Ubiquiti’s proven airMAX TDMA protocol for enhanced performance in noisy environments.

Whether you need a wireless bridge or point-to-multipoint subscriber module, the NSM5 is perfect for ISPs, remote monitoring, VoIP, or Wi-Fi extension across open distances. It combines a sleek form factor with professional-grade features.


Key Features:

  • Frequency: 5.1 – 5.8 GHz

  • Integrated 16 dBi high-gain panel antenna

  • Throughput: 150+ Mbps real TCP/IP

  • Range: Up to 15+ km (with line-of-sight)

  • airMAX TDMA protocol for collision-free performance

  • Passive PoE support (24V)

  • Compact and weatherproof enclosure

  • Easy setup via Ubiquiti airOS interface


Link Distance:

  • Point-to-Point (PTP): Up to 15 km+

  • Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP): 5–10 km (as CPE unit)


Ideal For:

  • ISP subscriber connectivity

  • Rural broadband distribution

  • Wi-Fi extension between buildings

  • CCTV & IP camera wireless backhaul

  • Educational or industrial campus links
